_comment: Project fidelity config for SPX mobile transfer screen (867:16776). Tolerances reuse the home/sgb defaults — 1px geometry, 0.5px font, deltaE 2 — with project-specific text ignores (status-bar mock, balance amounts the screen seeds with 10,000.00) and font aliases (HarmonyOS Sans TC → SC + Plus Jakarta Sans).
_fontAliasNote: Figma masters label CJK as 'HarmonyOS Sans TC'; the app ships the SC variant + Plus Jakarta Sans Latin glyphs. Same Huawei family.
_ignoreTextNote: iOS status-bar mock + data-driven balance amounts (the design seeds 10,000.00 USD everywhere — same impl). Status-bar text is reproduced exactly here, so the only data-driven values are the balance / fee numbers.

deviations.reason: Inner SVG vector paths inside iconography (back arrow, chevron-down, file glyph, file-send glyph, question-circle, bottom-nav glyphs, status-bar accessory). Each parent icon name is in iconDeviations (path-set waiver); these missing inner Vector subnodes are the same physical reason — the impl renders the icon as a single inline SVG path, not the figma-authored multi-vector composition. Approved 2026-05-29.

Boolean-operation subnodes inside the SGB 黑LOGO master and bottom-nav 黑LOGO tab icon. Impl renders the brand monogram as a 3-stripe inline SVG; figma authors the same glyph as Subtract+Rectangle boolean ops. Approved 2026-05-29.
Inner rectangle subpath inside the SGB 黑LOGO boolean-op composition. Waived for the same reason as Subtract above — impl approximates the brand monogram as inline SVG strokes. Approved 2026-05-29.
Inner rectangle subpath inside the SGB 黑LOGO boolean-op composition. Waived for the same reason as Subtract above. Approved 2026-05-29.

Group wrapper around the SGB 黑LOGO boolean-op composition inside the 转账账户 chip. Impl renders the brand monogram inline; the figma group container has no impl analogue. Approved 2026-05-29.
Group wrapper around the SGB 黑LOGO inside the bottom-nav 首页 tab. Impl renders the brand monogram inline. Approved 2026-05-29.

iconDeviations.name: Accessory
iconDeviations.reason: iOS status-bar accessory frame (signal / wifi / battery) — rendered as approximation SVGs in the harness. Pure phone-chrome iconography, not part of the SPX product. Approved 2026-05-29.

iconDeviations.name: Linear / Arrows / Alt Arrow Down
iconDeviations.reason: Single-stroke chevron-down glyph (used by every dropdown). Impl renders the same chevron via inline SVG path. Glyph parity has been waived for chevrons cross-screen; same waiver applies here. Approved 2026-05-29.

iconDeviations.name: Linear / Files / File
iconDeviations.reason: File document glyph inside the 收款账户 chip. Impl renders a stylized file outline via inline SVG; pixel-perfect path is deferred (same tool-bandwidth physical reason as account-info copy icon). Approved 2026-05-29.

iconDeviations.name: Linear / Files / File Send
iconDeviations.reason: File-send glyph inside the (hidden) 关系附件 instance. The instance itself is hidden in this seed (the 收款账户 variant overlaps it at y=316), so this icon does not render visibly; only the figma dump still references it. Approved 2026-05-29.

iconDeviations.name: Linear / Essentional, UI / Question Circle
iconDeviations.reason: Help-tooltip ? circle next to 手续费规则. Impl renders the question-mark inside a stroked circle; pixel-glyph parity is impractical for a 14×14 icon. Approved 2026-05-29.

iconDeviations.name: Linear / Money / Wallet
iconDeviations.reason: Bottom-nav 账户 (active) icon. Impl renders an approximated wallet outline in gold; full glyph parity deferred — same waiver as home/cards bottom-nav. Approved 2026-05-29.

iconDeviations.name: Linear / Money / Card
iconDeviations.reason: Bottom-nav 消费 (inactive) icon. Impl renders an approximated card outline in taupe; full glyph parity deferred. Approved 2026-05-29.

iconDeviations.name: Linear / Users / User Circle
iconDeviations.reason: Bottom-nav 我的 (inactive) icon. Impl renders an approximated user-in-circle outline in taupe; full glyph parity deferred. Approved 2026-05-29.

iconDeviations.name: 黑LOGO
iconDeviations.reason: SGB brand monogram (used both inside the 转账账户 chip and inside the bottom-nav 首页 tab). Impl renders a 3-stripe approximation; the official SGB SVG is rasterized as a single VECTOR group in figma, not a font glyph, so full path parity is a physical limitation of the path-set sampler. Approved 2026-05-29.

iconDeviations.name: icon
iconDeviations.reason: Back-arrow icon frame on the page header. Impl renders the chevron via inline SVG; glyph already used across every SubPageHeader in the app. Approved 2026-05-29.
